name: Hina Youmiya
bio: Hina Youmiya (羊宮 妃那, Yōmiya Hina, born March 26, 2000) is a Japanese voice actress (seiyuu) from Nara Prefecture who is affiliated with Aoni Production. In 2024, she won the New Voice Actor Award at the 18th Seiyuu Awards.
